summary: Fish Audio offers s2.1-pro-free — the same TTS model as the paid S2.1-Pro — at $0 for development, testing, and prototyping. Same quality and 83-language coverage as s2.1-pro, under fair-use limits, with no TTFA or DPA guarantees and no published end date. Fish Audio's terms limit non-paying users to internal, personal, non-commercial use; commercial use needs a paid Fish plan. The same free model is also served on OpenRouter as fish-audio/s2.1-pro-free:free at $0. On Fish's native API, Starter accounts below $100 in total prepaid amount have a five-concurrent-request API limit shared across all account keys and API requests, including speech-to-text. This is not a fixed QPM allowance; exceeding the native API limit returns 429 without Retry-After, so use exponential backoff. Payment is not required to use the free model.
claim_steps: Create an account and API key at fish.audio.

Call POST https://api.fish.audio/v1/tts with your Bearer API key and the exact HTTP header model: s2.1-pro-free. Do not omit or misspell the model header: missing or unrecognized values fall back to paid s2.1-pro.

On Starter (below $100 total prepaid), keep all keys and API workloads within the shared five-concurrent-request limit. On native API 429 responses, retry with exponential backoff; no Retry-After header is returned.
Or use OpenRouter: with an OpenRouter API key, call POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/audio/speech with model fish-audio/s2.1-pro-free:free (free endpoints are rate-limited).
Free use is limited to personal, non-commercial projects; get a paid Fish Audio plan for commercial use.
